mentions.name: yups.io
mentions.description: A gateway service that redirects URLs to the correct proxy/frontend. It supports an official syntax like ?url=<target> as well as flexible URL formats for error handling.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just published a first version of a gateway that redirects to the correct proxy/frontend

https://yups.io

The "official" syntaxis is

https://yups.io/?url=https://twitter.com/Wikipedia
